Entries.SlimeEggPress_Description: 100 dona shilimshiqni shilimshiq tuxumga siqadi. Bu fan mo‘jizasi!
Entries.SlimeIncubator_Description: Shilimshiq tuxumlaridan shilimshiqlarni ochiradi. Shilimshiqlarni tashqarida boqish imkonini beradi.
Entries.SlothSkeletonL_Description: Bu qirilib ketgan yalqov Stardew Valley vodiysining yam-yashil tarixdan oldingi o‘rmonlarida kezgan. Uning kuchli jag‘lari eng qattiq o‘simlik tolalarini ham uzib tashlagan.
Entries.SlothSkeletonR_Description: Tarixdan oldingi yalqovning orqa oyoqlari va dumi.
Entries.SolarPanel_Description: Quyoshda qoldirilsa, batareyalarni asta-sekin ishlab chiqaradi.
Entries.Staircase_Description: Konlarda bir qavat pastga tushish uchun foydalaning.
Entries.StandingGeode_Description: Tagkursiga o‘rnatilgan ulkan geoda. Ichida yuzlab binafsha kristallar yaltiraydi.
Entries.StardewHeroTrophy_Description: Stardew Valley fuqarosi olishi mumkin bo‘lgan eng nufuzli mukofot!
Entries.StatueOfBlessings_Description: Haykalga tegish har kuni o‘ziga xos baraka beradi.
Entries.StatueOfEndlessFortune_Description: Sof oltindan yasalgan. Bu nima uchun kerak?
Entries.StatueOfTheDwarfKing_Description: Har kuni konchilikka oid ikki kuchdan birini tanlang.
Entries.StoneOwl_Secret_Description: Buning qayerdan kelgani noma’lum, ammo juda chiroyli ko‘rinadi.
Entries.StoneSign_Description: Ko‘rsatilayotgan narsani o‘zgartirish uchun buyum ishlating. Buyum sarflanmaydi.
Entries.StrangeCapsule_Description: Suyuqlik ichida nimadir go‘shtli narsa suzib yuribdi...
Entries.Tapper_Description: Zarang, eman yoki qarag‘ayga o‘rnating va idish mahsulot bilan to‘lguncha kuting!
Entries.Telephone_Description: Do‘kon ish vaqti va zaxirasini tekshirish uchun foydalanish mumkin.
Entries.TextSign_Description: Bu belgiga o‘zingiz xohlagan xabarni yozishingiz mumkin.
Entries.TuboFlowers_Description: Eman bochkasiga ekilgan gullar. Bahor va yozda ochiladi.
Entries.WickedStatue_Description: Bu haykalning ko‘rinishida bezovta qiluvchi nimadir bor.
Entries.WoodChair_Description: To‘rt xil yo‘nalishda qo‘yish mumkin bo‘lgan stul.
Entries.WoodChipper_Description: Qattiq yog‘och bo‘lagini solib, uni oddiy yog‘ochga aylantiring.
Entries.WoodSign_Description: Ko‘rsatilayotgan narsani o‘zgartirish uchun buyum ishlating. Buyum sarflanmaydi.
Entries.Workbench_Description: Bu yerda yasaganda, yonidagi istalgan sandiqlardagi materiallardan foydalanishingiz mumkin.
Entries.WormBin_Description: Muntazam ravishda yem ishlab chiqaradi. Chuvalchanglar o‘zini o‘zi ta’minlaydi.
